newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ABB buys two Canadian firms.
newsitem.headline: ABB buys two Canadian firms.

text.p: Electrical engineering group ABB Asea Brown Boveri AG said it had acquired two Canadian oil and gas companies that employ a total of 120 employees and have annual revenues of more than $20 million.

ABB said in a statement that the acquisition of Rector Canada Inc. and Walker Steel, a division of Emco Ltd, would equip ABB with additional service, manufacturing and after-sales capabilities to better serve ABB's Canadian customers in this expanding market.
Both companies are based in Calgary, Alberta and have subsidiary operations in Edmonton.
ABB said the Canadian market for oil, gas and petrochemicals equipment and services is forecast to increase in importance and activity in the coming years.
ABB's oil, gas and petrochemical business activities focuses on teh development and upgrading of oil and gas installations, refineries and petrochemical and chemical installations.
